title: Mission: Buy What You Need
description: Combine quantities, origin, destination and a polite request in one practical market errand.

data.heading: Mission: Buy what you need
data.body: Listen to the useful sequence. You will say where you are from, ask for useful amounts, and make one request without an ingredient.

data.prompt_en: Listen once for the mission, then again for the one item without something.
data.transcript_cz: Jsem z Brna. Prosím kilo jablek a litr mléka. Potom si dám kávu bez cukru a jdu do práce.

data.prompt_en: Use the image and read for the plan.
data.image_label: A market errand followed by coffee
data.text_cz: Marek je z Olomouce. Ráno jde do práce přes trh. Kupuje kilo jablek pro kolegy a litr mléka domů. Před prací si dává kávu bez cukru.
data.text_en: Marek is from Olomouc. In the morning he goes to work via the market. He buys a kilo of apples for colleagues and a litre of milk for home. Before work he has coffee without sugar.

data.explanation: Use the chunks to make a practical story.
